title: Integrative Single-Cell and Bulk Transcriptomic Analyses with Spatial Validation Identify a Residual Fatty Acid-EMT Subset Driving Chemotherapy Resistance in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer via MIF- and MK-Mediated Ligand-Receptor Signaling.
snippet: Chemotherapy resistance in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) remains a critical clinical challenge, with a substantial proportion of patients failing to achieve pathological complete response following neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC).
